decision: treat the work as a multi-phase TUI parity migration, not a terminal-renderer rewrite
why: the audited gaps cross model setup, protocol, client session control, semantic activity, and rendering

decision: preserve the existing untracked fixture and workflow data
why: those files predate this run and belong to the user

decision: pin the current focused unit baseline before editing
why: changes need a treatment comparison on current main
evidence: pnpm --filter eve exec vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts with eight focused files

decision: keep the featured viewport, then sort each catalog tier by released descending
why: featured entries must remain a leading run; the public catalog exposes released as Unix seconds for all 305 observed entries

decision: map Fast mode to gateway.serviceTier priority
why: Codex models fast mode as a service tier and AI Gateway documents priority as faster processing at increased cost
evidence: openai/codex service_tier_resolution.rs and chatwidget/service_tiers.rs; Vercel AI Gateway service tiers docs

decision: keep tool calls independently keyed and derive semantic presentation before coalescing
why: calls can finish out of order and finalized blocks cannot be retroactively grouped

decision: do not persist the renderer stderr buffer directly
why: it misses boot failures and contains unredacted arbitrary output without stable correlation

decision: use candidate A as the base and graft catalog validation, custom-tier state, and serialized diagnostics
why: it preserves atomic model changes, exhaustive tool lifecycle, and parent-owned diagnostic lifecycle while respecting current picker constraints
evidence: three independent design candidates plus design judge

decision: initially defer coalescing, full Markdown, composer steering, attachments, and remaining session controls
why: those require additional adapter/runtime or width-aware rendering contracts and are not prerequisites for the first safe tranche
result: coalescing and Markdown later unblocked in this run; conversation controls remain deferred

decision: coalesce adjacent same-status semantic calls in the display layer only
why: parallel calls remain keyed by call id; holding a cohort live until every call settles preserves out-of-order lifecycle updates

decision: vendor marked and render parsed GFM tokens within terminal width
why: the existing regex line renderer could not represent fenced blocks, nested lists, links, tasks, or width-bounded tables without accumulating ambiguous parsing branches

decision: prove the tranche at module, package, and TUI-artifact boundaries
why: unit behavior alone cannot prove vendored runtime availability or atomic filesystem behavior
evidence: 4867 unit tests passed; 480 integration tests passed; typecheck; guard:invariants; packed-install TUI /model smoke
result: passed; full server-backed TUI suite separately obstructed by an existing inbound listener on port 3000 and the alternate-port run ended in an environment fetch failure
